Indian Junior Men's Hockey Team to Tour Belgium for Exposure

The Indian Junior Men's Hockey Team is scheduled to embark on an exposure tour to Belgium. This tour is intended to provide valuable experience and preparation for the team. The trip is set to take place ahead of the upcoming Asia Cup.
